# Kition Tessera Support

## Questions about using Tessera

Start with the docs at [tessera.kition.ai](https://tessera.kition.ai) (the same pages as
Markdown are in [`docs/`](../docs/README.md)).

## Bug Reports

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-tessera/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
for a reproducible problem in a component, an icon, or a token. Search existing issues first and
include the package, its version or commit, the browser, and the smallest code that shows it.

## Requests

Use the [request form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-tessera/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
for a missing icon, a component, a change to one, or a mistake in the documentation.

## Security Reports

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Follow the
[security policy](SECURITY.md).

## Contribution Help

Questions about local setup, checks, or pull requests start with
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
